description: The `kit_file.rs` JSDoc/augmentation long-tail from #2108, under `checkJs`: a `@type` sharing one line with `@typedef` (TypeScript's scanner parses several tags per line, so official suppresses the augmentation where rsvelte used to inject), and a rest parameter (official's `parameters.length` counts it; oxc keeps it out of `params.items`, so `entries` used to be augmented as if it took none and a rest-parameter `load` used to be skipped).
